analyzed_vuln.description: In json_HEADER, numeric JSON primitives are parsed into a local `long num` (8 bytes on x86_64) and then passed to `dwg_dynapi_header_set_value(dwg, key, &num, 0)` without validating the destination field width. `dwg_dynapi_header_set_value` forwards to `dynapi_set_helper`, which does `memcpy(old, value, f->size)`. For header fields like `layer_colors` element type `RC` (1 byte), metadata `f->size` is much larger (256), so memcpy reads 256 bytes from the stack address of `num`, causing the ASan stack-buffer-overflow read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Via llvmfuzz JSON path (`data[0]=='{'`), a crafted HEADER key that resolves to a dynapi header field with mismatched metadata/size (PoC uses `layer_colors[128]`) and is handled by the integer primitive branch in `json_HEADER` triggers the bug. Data flow: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput -> dwg_read_json -> json_HEADER -> dwg_dynapi_header_set_value -> dynapi_set_helper memcpy. The trigger requires selecting a key whose dynapi field size exceeds the local source variable size (`long num`).
